headline: Pacific Edge Shares Rise After US Medicare Covers Tests
summary: Shares in Dunedin-based cancer diagnostics company Pacific Edge increased following Medicare coverage approval for its cancer-marker urine tests.
why: Pacific Edge develops and commercializes diagnostic biomarker tests for cancer detection, relying heavily on health insurance and government reimbursement approvals.

impacts.name: Pacific Edge
impacts.why: Medicare coverage expands the addressable market and potential revenue for its tests.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company's share price rose after securing Medicare coverage for its diagnostic tests, opening broader reimbursement channels in the United States.
